summary.name: Mac Mouse Fix
summary.one_liner: Mac Mouse Fix is a macOS utility that adds trackpad-style gestures, smoothed scrolling, and button actions to third-party mice.
use_cases: Bringing trackpad gestures to a cheap third-party mouse
Smoother, more controllable scrolling on macOS
Assigning keyboard-shortcut actions to mouse buttons
Switching desktops or viewing windows with mouse buttons
Using a trackbal or vertical mouse without its vendor driver on Mac
summary.what_it_does: Mac Mouse Fix maps mouse buttons 4 and 5 to trackpad-style actions such as Mission Control, desktop switching, Launchpad, back/forward page navigation, and zoom. It offers a momentum-based scrolling option with High, Regular, and Off smoothness settings, and it can reverse scroll direction independently of the trackpad. Any mouse button can be assigned an action such as Smart Zoom or a keyboard-shortcut equivalent like copy, paste, or opening a new Safari tab. The source code is published on GitHub.
notable: Open source, with source code on GitHub
Brings trackpad gestures to mice with at least 5 buttons
Free for 30 days of active use before purchase
caveats: Costs $2.99 as stated on the page, plus local taxes and possible PayPal currency fees
Does not currently support the Apple Magic Mouse
Some mice using proprietary drivers such as Logitech Options may not have all buttons recognized
Full trackpad-style gesture set requires a mouse with at least 5 buttons
